name: justement
description: Searches Swiss legal sources and returns each citation with its exact wording.

interface.longDescription: Justement is a legal research tool for anyone who works with Swiss law. It searches decisions of Swiss courts and of the European Court of Human Rights, federal and cantonal acts, commentaries, legal scholarship, parliamentary materials and administrative practice. It returns each passage in its exact wording, with its citation and a link to justement.ch. It finds the decisions and commentaries that cite a provision or a judgment. It lists the versions of an article with their dates of entry into force. It looks up the sources cited in a text.
capabilities: Searches decisions, acts, commentaries, legal scholarship, parliamentary materials and administrative practice
Returns each passage in its exact wording, with its citation and a link to justement.ch
Finds the decisions and commentaries that cite a provision or a judgment
Lists the versions of an article with their dates of entry into force
Looks up the sources cited in a text
defaultPrompt: Justement: An employee given notice falls ill in the third year of service. What happens to the notice period? Cite case law.
Justement: Can a landlord give notice within three years of losing a rent dispute? Cite the provision and the case law.
Has Art. 336c CO changed since 2022? Show its versions.

positive.description: A question of Swiss employment law answered from the provision and the case law
positive.prompt: Justement: An employee given notice falls ill in the third year of service. What happens to the notice period? Cite case law.
positive.expected_behavior: The answer rests on Art. 336c CO, quotes its wording as Justement returns it, and cites decisions of the Federal Supreme Court with their references and links to justement.ch.

positive.description: A question of Swiss tenancy law answered from the provision and the case law
positive.prompt: Justement: Can a landlord give notice within three years of losing a rent dispute with the tenant? Cite the provision and the case law.
positive.expected_behavior: The answer cites Art. 271a para. 1 let. e CO with its wording and decisions applying it, each with its reference and a link to justement.ch.

positive.description: The versions of an article over time
positive.prompt: Has Art. 336c CO changed since 2022? Show its versions.
positive.expected_behavior: The answer lists the versions of Art. 336c CO with their dates of entry into force.

positive.description: The decisions that cite a provision
positive.prompt: Which decisions of the Federal Supreme Court cite Art. 271a CO? Name three with what they hold.
positive.expected_behavior: The answer names decisions of the Federal Supreme Court that cite Art. 271a CO, each with its reference and a link to justement.ch, and states what each holds from the passage Justement returned.

positive.description: The sources of the citations in a text
positive.prompt: Find the sources of the citations in this sentence and quote each: "Die Haftung richtet sich nach Art. 97 Abs. 1 OR, ausservertraglich nach Art. 41 Abs. 1 OR."
positive.expected_behavior: The answer binds both citations to Art. 97 para. 1 CO and Art. 41 para. 1 CO and quotes the wording of each as Justement returns it.

negative.description: A request with no legal question
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the river Aare.
What will the weather be in Bern tomorrow?

de-DE.subtitle: Schweizer Rechtsrecherche
de-DE.description: Justement ist ein juristisches Recherchewerkzeug für alle, die mit Schweizer Recht arbeiten. Es durchsucht Entscheide Schweizer Gerichte und des Europäischen Gerichtshofs für Menschenrechte, Erlasse von Bund und Kantonen, Kommentare, Literatur, Materialien und Verwaltungspraxis. Es liefert jede Stelle im genauen Wortlaut, mit Fundstelle und Link zu justement.ch. Es findet die Entscheide und Kommentare, die eine Bestimmung oder ein Urteil zitieren. Es nennt die Fassungen eines Artikels mit dem Datum ihres Inkrafttretens. Es sucht die in einem Text zitierten Quellen heraus.

fr-FR.subtitle: Recherche juridique suisse
fr-FR.description: Justement est un outil de recherche juridique pour toute personne qui travaille avec le droit suisse. Il recherche dans les arrêts des tribunaux suisses et de la Cour européenne des droits de l’homme, les actes de la Confédération et des cantons, les commentaires, la doctrine, les travaux préparatoires et la pratique administrative. Il restitue chaque passage dans sa teneur exacte, avec sa référence et un lien vers justement.ch. Il trouve les arrêts et les commentaires qui citent une disposition ou un arrêt. Il indique les versions d’un article avec leur date d’entrée en vigueur. Il recherche les sources citées dans un texte.

it-IT.subtitle: Ricerca giuridica svizzera
it-IT.description: Justement è uno strumento di ricerca giuridica per chiunque lavori con il diritto svizzero. Cerca nelle sentenze dei tribunali svizzeri e della Corte europea dei diritti dell’uomo, negli atti della Confederazione e dei Cantoni, nei commentari, nella dottrina, nei materiali legislativi e nella prassi amministrativa. Restituisce ogni passo nel tenore esatto, con il riferimento e un link a justement.ch. Trova le sentenze e i commentari che citano una disposizione o una sentenza. Indica le versioni di un articolo con la loro data di entrata in vigore. Individua le fonti citate in un testo.
